records.description: A community platform where users post problems, devs build solutions, and the community votes on the best.

records.name: Venturisy
records.tagline: experiences platform and providers tools
records.description: The world of tourism is full of local guides and creators, yet many struggle with visibility and booking. Travelers often miss out on authentic experiences, stuck with generic packages. Venturisy bridges this gap. We provide a dedicated platform where tourism professionals—from independent guides to agencies—can list and manage their services. Our mission is to connect passionate creators with travelers seeking unique adventures, making authentic travel accessible for everyone.

records.name: QuickTools — Dev & Productivity Tools
records.tagline: 168 free browser tools. No signup. No BS. 100% private.
records.description: 168 free browser tools — no signup, no uploads, no tracking. Every tool runs 100% client-side in JavaScript. Your data never leaves your device. AI tools (summarizer, sentiment, email writer), developer tools (JSON, regex, JWT), design (color picker, gradients), security (passwords, hashing), business (invoices, ROI), student tools (GPA, citations), women's health (cycle tracker), senior tools (medication reminder, emergency card), and more. Opens in <1s. Works on mobile.

records.name: ContextCore
records.tagline: Your AI agentic coding history, searchable and MCP-ready
records.description: ContextCore is the searchable, composable memory layer for AI-assisted development. Ingest from Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and more; search with lexical and semantic tools; expose memory via MCP.

records.name: Vasta
records.tagline: All-in-one platform for creating and publishing content
records.description: Centralize insights, creation, copy, scheduling, and analytics in one platform to produce content for every social channel.

records.name: tmux-grid
records.tagline: a visual tmux layout builder
records.description: Getting into tmux can be daunting, especially if you're coming from a place where the pane grid is just pre-done for you! But it doesn't need to be! With tmux-grid you can predefine your grid layout and add it to your tmux config!

records.name: Notion Diff
records.tagline: Compare Notion pages side-by-side like git diff.
records.description: Compare any two Notion pages side-by-side, just like git diff. Features: ✅ Side-by-side/Unified diff view ✅ Word-level highlighting — See exactly what changed ✅ Rich rendering — All Notion formatting preserved (Pro) ✅ Notion History — Compare current vs past versions (Pro)

records.name: Moviexto
records.tagline: Daily Movie Guessing Game
records.description: Moviexto is a daily semantic movie guessing game that challenges you to find the secret movie with the help of AI.

records.name: LogCase: Full-Colour E-Paper iPhone Case
records.tagline: Full-colour E-Paper iPhone case. No battery. Powered by NFC.
records.description: LogCase Full Colour is an iPhone case with a full-colour E Ink display, powered by NFC energy harvesting. No battery inside. No charging port. No cables. Ever. Using the LogCase app, set any image on the back — a photo, artwork, or your own design. Once set, it stays with zero power consumption, even when your iPhone is off. E Ink Spectra 6 display. MagSafe compatible. Aerospace-grade build. Live on Kickstarter. Early Bird $69 (30% off). Ships June 2026 for iPhone 17 Pro / Pro Max.

records.name: Visuality
records.tagline: Show your products in AR from any e-commerce product page
records.description: Visuality lets e-commerce merchants showcase products in 3D and augmented reality. Customers view products in AR directly in their browser — no app needed. Key features: - AI converts product photos into 3D models in minutes - Native Shopify & PrestaShop modules - QR codes for print catalogs and trade shows - 3D configurator for color and material variants - Offline Android app for trade show demos Starts at €29.99/mo. 7-day free trial, no credit card.

records.name: Clavex AI
records.tagline: Managed OpenClaw hosting. EU jurisdiction. Zero setup.
records.description: OpenClaw has 338K GitHub stars — but every managed hosting option or AI agent puts your data on their servers, under their laws, used however they see fit. Clavex AI gives you your own private, always-on OpenClaw instance hosted in Germany under EU law. Connect via WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, etc. in minutes. No setup, no servers, no engineers needed. Just your AI agent, running 24/7, completely yours. No setup. No US jurisdiction. No data sharing. Your AI. Your data. Your jurisdiction.

records.name: Content Idea Generator
records.tagline: Get 10 social media post ideas for any niche in seconds
records.description: Generate unlimited social media content ideas for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook in seconds. Free tool for coaches, small business owners, and creators. Pick your platform, enter your niche, choose your goal, and get 10 ready-to-use post ideas. No signup, no email required.

records.name: Make a sticky Notes
records.tagline: A public wall of sticky notes from people around the world
records.description: Ever wanted to leave a note somewhere… and have strangers discover it? MakeStickyNotes is a playful space where anyone can create a sticky note, customize it, and pin it to a live public board. It’s part creativity tool, part social experiment. 💡 Write a thought 🎨 Make it yours with stickers 🌍 Watch others add theirs in real time Some notes are funny. Some are deep. Some are just… random. That’s what makes it interesting. Try it → what would you leave behind?

records.name: Intellixy
records.tagline: Chat with your PDFs using AI
records.description: 🚀 Intellixy – Chat with your PDFs using AI Reading PDFs is slow, boring, and inefficient. So I built Intellixy. 👉 Upload any PDF 👉 Ask questions like ChatGPT 👉 Get instant answers, summaries & insights No more endless scrolling. No more wasting hours. ✨ Perfect for: * Students * Developers * Researchers 💡 Free plan available 💰 Pro plan for unlimited usage Would love your feedback 🙌 Try it here 👉 https://intellixy.vercel.app #AI #SaaS #Productivity #Startups
